title: Fields
description: What this board’s cards show. A field’s value belongs to the task, so it goes wherever the task does.
fromOtherEmpty: Your other fields are all on this board already.

delete.bodyNoValues: It comes off {boards}. No task has a value in it yet.

hints.stopwatch: Counts how long a task has been in work. Start and stop it on the task, or let the board do it: its automations start the stopwatch, restart it in each column and stop it when the task is done.
hints.timer: Counts down a length of time you set on a task: half an hour, a day, a week. When it runs out, the card says “Time is up” and counts the overrun.
hints.time_tracking: Planned and actual time on a task. The card shows them side by side, and the actual time turns red when it passes the plan.

automations.start_on_arrival: Start when a task appears on the board: created here or moved in from another board
automations.restart_on_move: Restart when a task moves to another column, and count the time in each column
automations.stop_on_done: Stop when the task is done
